title: The Power of Desire and Patience
content: One feels the taste of anything due to the pride of desire. If it is difficult, more pride arises. If it is very far, lust arises. For the Supreme Being, it is even further. So far that even sound does not reach. So far that even its silence becomes a test. What is so far from oneself, there is no need for pride at all.
raw_text: Kissi bhi cheeze ko pane ka ras ahankar se aata hai. Agar vo muskil hai to aur ahankar hota hai. Agar vo bahot dur hai to vasana hoti hai lust aati hai. Pr parmatma. Vo to bhetar hai. Itne pass hai ke awaz bhi na deni pade. Itne pass hai ki uski silence bhi samz jaye. Jo itni pass hai usko apne ke liye ahankar ki koi jarurat nai hai.
